comments.body: Is there another quest/disco in this chain not listed? I've got Theseus and the Minotaur but cannot get it to pop at St. Pete with plenty adv fame and world lang reader.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: No, other then "The Story of a Bull Monster" listed above. Remember that if your having trouble pulling a particular quest you can always use the "Take Quest by Destination" feature, and select Eastern Europe (or whatever region you know where it ends at for the other quests) to help narrow it down.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body: Yeah, I tried that several times - only another quest (Passion and Trending, seems unrelated) would show that way. I must be missing something. Ty though.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: The chain info is correct. But some quests are "rare" and take a lot of QMP to generate, even if you meet all the conditions. Just keep trying, and remember that the Destination feature shows ALL eligiible quests in a region, so it may take multiple tries as well. Cheers.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
I figured it out! Seems the quest is uber picky about the skill requirements. Many quests are picky about language, but more lenient about the skill reqs. For my character pulling the quest was r7 geography rather than the required r8.

Paid a hefty price of almost 500 QMPs for my oversight X.X but at least it was pulled!
